top_signals.title: Real sustainability means getting serious about youth leadership
top_signals.summary: For decades, youth have been told they are the future. But when it comes to sustainability practices, are we truly listening to what they have to say?
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
